total_model.summary: Model projects 44.2 total points (PHI 19, PIT 25). Biggest factors: Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (lowers total 0.9), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.7), Combined rushing offense EPA/play (raises total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
